## Checklist

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/s3onghyun/token-yugong/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).

- [ ] `./test.sh` passes (macOS app), or `cargo test --manifest-path desktop/core/Cargo.toml` for a `desktop/` change
- [ ] A rule change in [LOGIC.md](https://github.com/s3onghyun/token-yugong/blob/main/LOGIC.md) comes with its unit test
- [ ] No analytics and no new network requests
- [ ] New UI text is one `L.t(en, ko, ja, zh)` call with all four languages
- [ ] No new or modified art under `assets/` (open an issue for art ideas)
- [ ] Material AI assistance, if any, is disclosed here, and I have read and tested every change
